title: Weekly financial statements
summary: This is a landing page for ECB's weekly financial statements publication schedule, explaining the Eurosystem's logistics for publishing weekly financial statements. The page contains publication timing rules, exceptions for quarter-end closings, and a table of 2026 publication date anomalies.
key_points: Weekly financial statements relate to the preceding Friday and publish on Tuesdays
First financial statement of each quarter publishes on Wednesday instead of Tuesday to allow time for quarterly revaluation
Publication schedule is adjusted when TARGET system is closed
2026 exception dates listed: January 7, April 9, July 8, October 7 (all Wednesday publications due to quarterly revaluation)
Easter Monday (April 6, 2026) is noted as a TARGET Closing Day affecting Week 14 publication
why_it_matters: This page documents the operational logistics of ECB data dissemination. It is not itself an economic release or policy communication; it merely schedules when weekly balance sheet data will become available.
